source.method: Centroid y 58..72 mm, radius 3.5..4.8 mm, |normal.y| <= 1e-4, |normal dot radial| >= .999. Strong rows additionally have all vertices in y 61.1096..71.121; orientation is clustered relative to the longest axial-span anchor modulo 60 deg.

study.method: Centroid y 58..72 mm, radius 3.5..4.8 mm, |normal.y| <= 1e-4, |normal dot radial| >= .999. Strong rows additionally have all vertices in y 61.1096..71.121; orientation is clustered relative to the longest axial-span anchor modulo 60 deg.

proposedInterface.frame: shaft-local CAD millimetres, +Y axial; one or more closed axial bands per feature; one objectToShaft Matrix4 per mesh

inputSunTeeth.semantics: COMMON functional ten-tooth band only. This is the only ten-fold band authenticated in both source and study.
exclusions: Study-only hob lead-out after the functional face.

inputSixfold.semantics: Distinct far-end six-flat band, including its end lead-out through the shaft tip.

excludedLowerApproach.reason: Near-circular/tessellated approach: the y=61.10 control has sixfold variance fraction only .034-.037 and lacks the six strong coplanar normal clusters; the distinct feature begins at the 61.1096 ring.

variantExtension.contractCorrection: A full-surface/lead-out proof needs variant-selected bands (sourceP001835 vs studyApproved). The shared functional band above is sufficient for strict tooth-identity comparison; do not attach the study-only lead-out to source P001835.

coordinateShader.existingVShaftLocal: Yes on study legacy/approved shaft materials patched by applyProgression (and overlays/caps sharing those uniforms). It is NOT guaranteed on unpatched source-rig materials or arbitrary proof clones.
coordinateShader.sourceRule: Compute a fresh objectToShaft from each live mesh.matrixWorld and the proof scene registration; do not reuse the raw Default.glb node transform after rig baking/consolidation.

divergentRegions: Study approved shaft retains a ten-fold hob lead-out to y 13.938684 mm; source P001835-2 does not share it.
